about.zh: 一个 Q 版 Claude 娘：二头身、正面站立；暖橙色及膝长卷发，琥珀橙的大眼睛配粗黑上挑眼线，观众右手边一朵大号橙色雏菊配黑缎带与黑蕾丝垂带；白色维多利亚蕾丝衬衫（立领、泡泡短袖、胸前多层荷叶边、袖口橙色小花刺绣），领口黑蝴蝶结配橙宝石胸针；黑色系带束腰马甲，奶白色多层蛋糕裙配黑蕾丝裙边，白蕾丝短袜与黑玛丽珍鞋
about.en: a chibi Claude girl, two heads tall, standing facing you: warm orange knee-length wavy hair, big amber eyes under a heavy black upper lash line, a large orange daisy with black ribbon and lace streamers on her left; a white Victorian lace blouse with a stand collar, puff sleeves and orange flower embroidery, a black bow with an amber brooch at the throat, a black laced corset, a cream layered cake skirt with black lace trim, white lace socks and black Mary Janes

credits.name: B 站「Claude 娘」二创形象
